title: A Retrieval-Augmented Automated Stakeholder for Requirements Elicitation Education: A Comparative Study
abstract: arXiv:2609.12576v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Developing the skills required for requirements engineering students to conduct effective requirements elicitation interviews is critical yet challenging, as it requires the development of soft skills in addition to technical knowledge. Role-playing is widely adopted in requirements engineering education to support the development of these skills but is often constrained by time and resource limitations. Although recent advances in large language models (LLMs) enable automated and interactive stakeholder simulations for role-playing, their application in requirements engineering education remains limited by hallucinations and inconsistent responses. To address these limitations, this study investigates the use of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), implemented using the LangChain framework, to support requirements elicitation activities in a requirements engineering course. translated_title: 面向需求获取教育的检索增强型自动化利益相关者：一项对比研究
translated_abstract: 培养需求工程学生进行有效需求获取访谈所需的技能至关重要却充满挑战，因为这除了技术知识之外，还需要发展软技能。角色扮演在需求工程教育中被广泛采用以支持这些技能的培养，但往往受到时间和资源限制的制约。尽管大语言模型（LLM）的最新进展使得自动化、交互式的利益相关者模拟角色扮演成为可能，但其在需求工程教育中的应用仍受限于幻觉和不一致的响应。为了解决这些局限性，本研究探讨了利用检索增强生成技术（RAG），并通过LangChain框架实现，以支持需求工程课程中的需求获取活动。我们对69名学生开展了对照实验，对比……
tldr: 本研究提出基于LangChain框架的检索增强生成（RAG）自动化利益相关者，以克服大语言模型在需求工程教育中的幻觉与响应不一致问题，并通过69名学生的对照实验验证了其在需求获取教学中的效果。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a RAG-based (LangChain) automated stakeholder to overcome LLM hallucinations and inconsistencies in requirements elicitation education, validated through controlled experiments with 69 students.
